# SimuPixel Free Glitch PBR Pack

Five original 2048 x 2048 seamless glitch materials created and exported only
with SimuPixel 1.0.1. No source images, AI image generation, external texture
tools, upscalers, or image post-processing were used.

## Free-to-use license

These assets are free to use for anyone, anywhere, in personal or commercial
projects. Attribution is appreciated but not required. You may modify and
redistribute the textures, including as part of a larger project. Do not resell
this pack by itself or claim authorship of the unmodified pack.

## Materials

| Folder | Material | Visual character |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `01_neon_fault_lattice` | Neon Fault Lattice | Broken magenta/cyan digital matrix |
| `02_datamosh_bloom` | Datamosh Bloom | Amber and acid-olive compression-like noise |
| `03_orbital_signal_ruins` | Orbital Signal Ruins | Fragmented lime/violet HUD circuitry |
| `04_phaseburn_interference` | Phaseburn Interference | Dense coral/teal wave collisions |
| `05_corrupted_chrome_memory` | Corrupted Chrome Memory | Metallic blue signal streaks and dropout bands |

Every material folder contains:

- editable `.glp` SimuPixel preset;
- 2048 x 2048 base-color PNG;
- `_height` grayscale height map;
- `_normal` tangent-space normal map (OpenGL / +Y);
- `_roughness` grayscale roughness map;
- `_ao` grayscale ambient-occlusion map;
- `_metallic` grayscale metallic map;
- `_specular` grayscale specular map;
- `_emission` RGB emission/base-color map;
- 512 x 512 quick-look preview.

All production maps are seamless, fully opaque PNGs. The material presets use
only SimuPixel's digital generators and glitch modifiers; none uses the wood,
stone, concrete, or woven-fabric surface layers.
